## Why this name

- reads the region tag at block+0x00, compares the address against the EWRAM end 0x0203FFFF, and pushes the block onto one of two free lists (0x03000B30 EWRAM / 0x03003F44 IWRAM) using the links at +0x08/+0x0C
- 25 callers across battle, graphics/VRAM teardown (sub_08061BAC) and text paths, so it is a generic two-region heap free, not battle-specific
